mechanism: Minocycline can cause photosensitivity and autoimmune reactions; ramipril increases risk of angioedema and renal dysfunction, with tetracyclines potentially increasing this risk and decreasing ACE inhibitor efficacy through altered renal hemodynamics.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and blood pressure regularly; counsel patient on sun protection and watch for signs of angioedema or autoimmune manifestations; ensure adequate hydration.
